comments.body:
# Overnight stabilisation session — state as of 2026-09-06 ~05:00 UTC

## Environment: measured before -> after

| | start | now |
|---|---|---|
| root disk | 81% (49G/60G) | **29%** (17G/60G) |
| memory available | 11-13% under load | **58%** |
| load avg (2 vCPU) | 5.08 | **0.74** |
| CloudWatch alarms | 24 | **4**, 0 INSUFFICIENT_DATA |
| Gerrit | HTTP 504 on fetch | **200 in 0.27s**, ls-remote 1s |
| review-bot | exited(0), silently down | healthy, voting |
| gate scratch | on ROOT filesystem | own 50G volume, 6% |

## Merged this session

`ca89152f` nginx edge 504 fix - `d92d97b0` force_new_store refusal (duplicate-ticket root cause) -
`1f7673cb` user_data gzip (unblocked `terraform plan`) - `8e14d667` reconcile-check retirement -
`12a10f3a` gate-scratch detector + runbook - `abca98db` detached-maintenance race fix -
2682 scanner promotion to Verified voting.

## Closed

`evileyed-nontoxic-urutu` (a68c) - `mechanical-bitter-basenji` (0cfc) -
`sharp-welloff-hammerkop` (283b). `renowned-corked-hapuku` (dcc3) is PASS-reviewed and blocked
only on gate-slot congestion.

## Root causes PROVEN (not merely plausible)

1. **Duplicate tickets** — rebar's Tier-2 eval harness wrote into the live store because
   `_init_via_symlink` returns before `force_new_store` is consulted when `.git` is a file.
2. **Gerrit 504s** — the nginx Gerrit `location /` had NO `proxy_read_timeout`, running on the
   compiled-in 60s default while every other proxied block set 3600s. 353 upload-pack POSTs, 14
   over 60s, all 14 returning HTTP 200 to Gerrit while nginx logged `504 167`: a gateway timeout,
   not a capacity problem.
3. **Missing host metrics** — `observability.sh` resolves its cap scripts as siblings
   (`/usr/local/bin/vartmp-cap.sh`) but their `--install` writes `rebar-`-prefixed names, so the
   probe got `rc=127`, budgets stayed unset, and the publish guards were false. Confirmed 4-for-4
   by natural experiment, and by installing the reapers and watching the metric STAY broken.
4. **Detached git-maintenance race** — `rebar init` committed twice before its own gc-config
   ensure pinned `maintenance.autoDetach=false`; the detached children outlived init and repacked
   the object DB. Trace2: 2 detached children before, 0 after.
5. **review-bot silent outage** — all containers use `unless-stopped`; review-bot `Exited (0)`,
   which that policy treats as intentional, so it did not restart even across a reboot that
   revived everything else. No LLM-Review source = nothing can merge, for 59 minutes, silently.

## Corrections worth carrying forward

- **Alarm state is not evidence.** Check DATAPOINTS. Four alarms were dead-man firings whose last
  values were comfortably inside their thresholds; the alarm count ROSE while the host improved,
  because the probe published less.
- **`OK` != `INSUFFICIENT_DATA`.** An alarm can leave ALARM by going blind rather than recovering.
- **Merged != deployed.** The nginx edge is detect-only under autodeploy; verify on the host.
  Conversely, deployment IS provable — the MCP container is named for its commit.
- **A client timeout does not cancel server work.** An MCP `transition_ticket` that timed out at
  300s had actually completed; I re-ran a billable review on an already-closed ticket because I
  checked against a STALE store.
- **The task-notification exit code is the last pipeline stage's**, not the command's. Capture rc
  to a file and read it before any pipe. Bit me once, and an agent twice.
- **`GATE_CONGESTED` is not a verdict.** The 4-slot semaphore is host-wide ACROSS CHECKOUTS; it
  blocked three closes and produced 12 false failures in one `make verify`. Never `--force` past it.

## Operator decisions outstanding

1. **Instance sizing** — four per-service limits sum to **9,088 MiB on a 7,813 MiB host**, pinned
   by a test that fails loudly rather than over-committing quietly. MCP alone is 2.87 GiB.
2. **Jira bridge re-enable** — 387/389 duplicates closed and independently verified; bridge stays
   DISABLED pending the checklist on `decrepit-blowy-javalina`.
3. **Rotate `JIRA_API_TOKEN`** — an agent expanded it into a transcript. No external transmission.

# HANDOFF STATE — 2026-09-06 ~06:00 UTC

Nothing is mid-mutation. No gate op was left half-applied. No `--force` was used anywhere.

## Agents still running (all SAFE to leave; none mutates production unprompted)

1. **r7g.large resize** — in PHASE 1 only: edits `infra/terraform/variables.tf`, runs
   `terraform plan`, pushes to Gerrit for review. It is explicitly instructed **not to apply** and
   to wait for an operator go-ahead before Phase 2. Approved cost ceiling is `r7g.large`
   ($78.18/mo vs $49.06 today); `c7g.xlarge` (+35%) and `m7g.xlarge` (+52%) are OUT.
2. **memory-bounding (`cryptozoic-unlit-ladybug`)** — running `make verify`; nothing committed or
   pushed until green. Will report a captured exit code, not the notification's.
3. **`lousy-unsuited-gnu`** — its change 2723 is MERGED; the agent has not yet filed its final
   report, which holds the AC evidence.

## Tickets closeable, with their exact remaining step

| ticket | state | next step |
|---|---|---|
| `ambitious-creative-ovenbird` (009f) | ACs ticked, file_impact widened 3->4 | attestation staled BY DESIGN -> `rebar review-plan`, then close |
| `lousy-unsuited-gnu` (94c5) | file_impact complete (2/2), 5 ACs unticked | wait for its agent's report, tick on that evidence, close |
| `prelawful-lumpish-clingfish` (3ce7) | **file_impact EMPTY** but commit touched 2 files; **no checkbox ACs at all** | set file_impact (`src/rebar/_commands/init.py`, `tests/unit/test_init_leaves_no_detached_upkeep.py`), add ACs, review, close |

## Close-gate rules learned the expensive way — check ALL of these BEFORE the first close attempt

dcc3 took five review passes because I discovered these one at a time:

1. Every `[non-codebase]` AC ticked `[x]` needs an indented `provenance:` line
   (environment / principal / privilege_posture / instrument).
2. A `[non-codebase]` AC must NOT cite a repo path — that is **attestation laundering**; split it,
   keeping the repo-verifiable half UNTAGGED.
3. Description must be **< 8000 chars** (P4 blocks, it is not advisory).
4. Heading must be literally `## Acceptance Criteria`.
5. `file_impact` must cover EVERY file in the merged commit.
6. Ticking a checkbox is attestation-SAFE; changing AC **text** or `file_impact` is MATERIAL and
   stales the attestation.

## Operator decisions outstanding

1. **Sizing** — approved at `r7g.large`, Phase 2 apply awaits go-ahead after the change merges.
   Expect a ~3-minute Gerrit outage (stop/start). Verify afterwards that gate-scratch is still
   mounted and that **review-bot came back** (it uses `unless-stopped` and did NOT restart after
   tonight's reboot, silently killing the LLM-Review vote source for 59 minutes).
2. **Jira bridge** — still DISABLED. 387/389 duplicates closed and independently verified;
   re-enable checklist is on `decrepit-blowy-javalina`.
3. **Rotate `JIRA_API_TOKEN`** — an agent expanded it into a transcript. No external transmission.

## Environment at handoff

Root 29% - memory 58% - load 0.74 - alarms 4 (0 INSUFFICIENT_DATA) - Gerrit HTTP 200 in 0.27s -
all four containers healthy - MCP on current main - all four reaper timers active.
The 4 remaining alarms are the two `var_tmp` + two `container` metrics, blocked on change **2722**
landing AND autodeploy re-materialising the probe. After that they should read **1**, not `-1`;
a `-1` would mean the installer half did not take.

## UPDATE — 2722 merged, alarm prediction now live

Change **2722** ("Let the probe reach the cap scripts it runs", `rebar-ticket: 5fb0-89ab-4466-41cc`)
is MERGED. **Zero open Gerrit changes.** Eleven changes merged this session.

That was the blocker named in the handoff section above for the four remaining alarms
(`container-reaper-not-active`, `container-writable-usage-high`, `var-tmp-cleanup-not-active`,
`var-tmp-usage-high`). The prediction to check on the next sweep, stated so it is falsifiable:

- The alarms clear only after autodeploy **re-materialises the probe** — merging alone is not
  enough. Verify on the host, not from the merge.
- When they do clear, the two heartbeats should read **1**, not **-1**. A `-1` means the three-value
  sentinel is working but the **installer half did not take**, which is a distinguishable and useful
  failure signature rather than an ambiguous non-recovery.
- **Caveat:** `octahedral-auburn-sunfish` records that autodeploy's `*_PATHS` do not list the cap
  scripts, so a cap-only change may reach no host until something else re-materialises the probe.
  If the alarms do not clear, that is the likely reason — not a bad fix.

Environment at this point: main green on the gating cell, Gerrit HTTP 200 in 0.27s, 4 alarms with 0
INSUFFICIENT_DATA, no open changes.
